review.brief: Validate tier 2 of RM61 (MAG-40) across commits df25e63, 6381a86, cb317a5 on ft/RM61-MAG-40-manual-charge-start-derivation. Read the DIFF, not the whole module. Checks: (1) module-boundary compliance - no HTML outside internal/gateway, no charging import in the VM file, no DB access from the gateway; (2) every doc-pack convention, especially ai/htmx-conventions.md and internal/gateway/AGENTS.md; (3) design.md D1-D7 each implemented as written, and the Test Contract groups A-F each covered by a real assertion; (4) the integration/handler tests assert design.md's authored expectations, NOT whatever the implementation happens to do - a test rewritten to match the code is a blocker finding; (5) i18n: every new user-facing string goes through i18n.T with both ES and EN non-empty; (6) Performance-Profile compliance (read-heavy); (7) no DB object changed - this tier has none, so any schema touch is a blocker; (8) B2 writing rule in every comment and doc, and NO comment citing design.md, a decision id, RM61, RD3, RD5 or MAG-40; (9) anti-gaming: no acceptance criterion weakened, no self-approved status, no test deleted to pass. Signals: gofmt -l, go build ./..., go vet ./..., make i18n-guard, make ui-guard were ASSISTANT-run and clean. make check was USER-run and reported passing by the owner. Judge test quality by READING the tests; never run the suite.
